name: Strike World
storyline:
You encountered Oragon on a floating island in Strike World. This island houses a variety of facilities and acts as the center of Strike World, connecting to the various worlds that heroes call home.
Each world has its own history and civilization, and is generally closed off from other worlds. However, there are special methods that make travel between worlds possible.
summary:
Pull, Aim, and STRIKE! — turn-based action.

Pull, aim, and STRIKE! The 64 million-total-player hit arrives in India! Unlock heroes, build your team, and crush bosses.

Intuitive Controls, Explosive Action!
No complex controls here! Just pull your hero, aim at the enemy, and release. Immerse yourself in simple yet deep, high-octane battles where every move counts. Your strategy changes everything!

Dynamic Stages and Tactical Battles!
As you progress, stages become more exciting and challenging. Skillfully break through intense situations using your ultimate team. The tougher the challenge, the greater the sense of achievement and the better the rewards!

Hundreds of Unique Heroes to Choose From!
The game features hundreds of unique heroes. Defeat bosses and collect fragments to unlock your favorite heroes, then power them up and build an unbeatable team to conquer even more difficult bosses.
